# 批量撤单 (TRADE)

- **DELETE** `/capi/v3/batchOrders`

权重(IP): 5

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| orderIdList | `Array<Long>` | 条件必填 | 最多 10 个订单 ID；当 `origClientOrderIdList` 留空时必填。 |
| origClientOrderIdList | `Array<String>` | 条件必填 | 最多 10 个客户端订单号，匹配 `^[\\.A-Z\:/a-z0-9_-]{1,36}$`；当 `orderIdList` 留空时必填。 |

**请求示例**

```
curl -X DELETE "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/batchOrders" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{
     "orderIdList": [702345678901234567, 702345678901234568]
   }'
```

**返回参数**

返回一个对象数组，这些对象遵循[取消订单（交易）](/api-doc/zh-CN/contract/Transaction_API/CancelOrder)中描述的数据结构。

**返回示例**

```
[
  {
    "orderId": "702345678901234567",
    "origClientOrderId": "",
    "success": true,
    "errorCode": "",
    "errorMessage": ""
  },
  {
    "orderId": "702345678901234568",
    "origClientOrderId": "",
    "success": false,
    "errorCode": "ORDER_NOT_FOUND",
    "errorMessage": "orderId not exist"
  }
]
```
